shared_elements: dense field of small incised script signs
horizontal register lines / rows of text
justification: Both surfaces carry closely packed rows of small incised signs organised in horizontal lines across a flat panel, which is a fairly specific shared convention of a text-covered surface. However, A also contains multiple seated and standing human figures before offering tables, arranged in distinct registers with a rounded top framed panel, while B shows only ruled text with no figural imagery at all.
